title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents built on large language models (LLMs) work in software that can change while they act: an appointment moves, a policy is revised, a record is updated. Testing agents under such changes is harder than it looks. When an agent fails, the cause may be the agent, but it may also be a change that did not fire as intended, an update the agent never received, or a grader that scored the episode wrongly. We introduce EnvOS, a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task. Before any agent runs, EnvOS checks that each change fires correctly, that the task remains solvable, and that the grader separates correct from incorrect behavior; after each run, separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence. We apply it to stale information, where a value the agent has already seen changes before the agent acts on it. In clinic booking, Claude Opus 5 succeeds on 0/16 tasks when nothing extra is shown,

translated_title: EnvOS：当世界发生变化时审计计算机使用智能体：基于现象的任务构建、认证与基于证据的评估
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的计算机使用智能体，在其执行动作的过程中所操作的软件可能发生变化：预约被改期、政策被修订、记录被更新。在此类变化下测试智能体比看起来更困难。当智能体失败时，原因可能在于智能体本身，但也可能是某项变化没有按预期触发、智能体从未接收到更新、或者评分器对整个运行过程做出了错误评分。我们提出了 EnvOS，一个用于构建和认证“任务中途会发生变化”的环境的框架。在任何智能体运行之前，EnvOS 会检查每项变化是否正确触发、任务是否仍然可解，以及评分器能否正确区分正确与错误行为；每次运行之后，独立的代码会基于存档的证据重新核查评分结论。我们将其应用于“信息过时”现象，即智能体已经看到的某个值在它据此行动之前发生了变化。在诊所预约任务中，当没有任何额外信息展示时，Claude Opus 5 在 16 个任务中成功 0 个（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出 EnvOS 框架，通过在智能体运行前认证环境变化触发、任务可解性与评分器有效性，并在运行后基于存档证据独立复核评分，解决了计算机使用智能体在任务中途发生变化的动态环境中失败归因困难的问题。
en_tdlr: EnvOS is a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task—verifying before each run that changes fire correctly, tasks remain solvable, and graders discriminate properly, then re-checking verdicts from archived evidence afterward—to enable reliable auditing of computer-use agents in dynamic software environments.
